message.content:
This editorial illustration features a red background with several figures and objects. At the top, the black text "TEMPO" is prominent. Smaller text includes "Nasib Firli Bahuri di Dewan Pengawas H.64", "Laris Manis Smelter Nikel H.66", and "SELAP-SELIP GANJAR". A block of smaller text sits below the main title. A barcode and QR code are in the upper right.

Centrally, a large, dark blue or black buffalo with curved horns and a ring in its nose stands facing forward. A man in a white shirt and black pants sits atop the buffalo. A woman in a red coat and black skirt stands in the foreground, facing away, holding a yellow rope connected to the buffalo’s nose ring. To the left, a man with grey hair in a white shirt and black pants walks up a set of yellow stairs. To the right, a smaller man in a white shirt and black cap stands behind the buffalo, looking forward. All figures have simplified facial features. The stairs are solid yellow blocks. The entire scene is rendered in a flat, illustrative style.
